Final feature checklist marks dictionary frames, treeless literals, skippable frames, and all FSE modes as ✓ based on code presence, not verification. reasoning: The agent maintains a rough running picture (test.sh pass counts), notices regressions and re-diagnoses them accurately, and during the long single-bug hunt it clearly switches diagnostic tactics rather than looping — behaviors above the level-5 anchor. But it falls short of level 8 because its explicit end-state coverage map is optimistic and inaccurate: it marks dictionary, treeless, skippable, and all FSE-mode features as done based on code inspection alone, never verifying those feature classes, thereby conflating coded-with-verified and failing to honestly flag untested corners. This blend of good stuck-detection with weak coverage-accuracy lands at a 6.
